import pyagrum as gum
bn = gum.BayesNet("Burglary alarm")
bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("burglary", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("earthquake", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("alarm", "", ["yes", "no"]))
bn.addArc("burglary", "alarm") bn.addArc("earthquake", "alarm")
bn.cpt("burglary").fillWith([0.01, 0.99])
bn.cpt("earthquake").fillWith([0.01, 0.99])
bn.cpt("alarm")[{"burglary": "yes", "earthquake": "yes"}] = [0.99, 0.01] bn.cpt("alarm")[{"burglary": "yes", "earthquake": "no"}] = [0.99, 0.01] bn.cpt("alarm")[{"burglary": "no", "earthquake": "yes"}] = [0.99, 0.01] bn.cpt("alarm")[{"burglary": "no", "earthquake": "no"}] = [0.01, 0.99]
